elements.title: Title and lead
elements.fulfilled_by: document/<name>.md › the # title, then a > lead block right under it

elements.title: At least one claim section
elements.fulfilled_by: document/<name>.md › a ## heading with at least one cited claim under it

elements.title: Every claim cited, with an in-place marker
elements.fulfilled_by: document/<name>.md › a [ID locator] bracket, or a Grounded, Inferred or Gap line, on every claim; the page links each point from its marker

elements.title: Citation points section
elements.fulfilled_by: computed by build_doc.py --data-links: section#citation-points in place of the type's Sources block, one li.cp-row per point the page uses, with its record id and locator, the verbatim text, the element it supports, and links to data-received.html#<ID> and citation-points.html#<anchor>
